title: On Rejuvenating the whole village after the fair
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：rejuvenate　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rejuvenate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the observer ① rejuvenated the whole village after the fair in public, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② rejuvenates the whole village after the fair in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ rejuvenate the whole village after the fair at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ rejuvenated the whole village after the fair before — a line in the log for November 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Rejuvenating the whole village after the fair in public, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ rejuvenate the tired soil with new crops in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Rejuvenate the tired soil with new crops at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ rejuvenates the tired soil with new crops in public every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ rejuvenated the whole village after the fair again when nobody else would.

⑩ To rejuvenate the whole village after the fair, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody rejuvenates the whole village after the fair in silence again and somebody must rejuvenate the whole village after the fair in public all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使年轻（一般过去式 rejuvenated the whole village after the fair：1993 年观测员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 使年轻（一般现在 rejuvenates the whole village after the fair：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使年轻（不定式 to rejuvenate the whole village after the fair：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使年轻（过去完成时 had rejuvenated the whole village after the fair：1987 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）

G. v. 使恢复（rejuvenate the tired soil with new crops：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使年轻（后段两处：新来的助手照例 rejuvenates the tired soil with new crops，而母亲又一次 rejuvenated the whole village after the fair）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rejuvenate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the observer rejuvenated the whole village after the fair in public, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer rejuvenates the whole village after the fair in silence whenever the observatory asks.
Rejuvenating the whole village after the fair in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever rejuvenate the tired soil with new crops in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
